author: agent
sentences: Last spring I changed how I price my small invoicing app.
The basic plan went from $12 a month to $29 a month, and I was sure people would leave.
Revenue that quarter came to $48,000, which paid for a second developer.
The lesson was *simple*, charge for the value, not for the hours.
If your customers save time with your tool, they will pay for it.

expected.say: from $12 a month to $29 a month

notes: FromTo with a from-frame between two monthly prices; a quarterly revenue figure; one emphasized word
